name: s023_3d_leakage_mesh
description: Mesh check of s014_3d_leakage, without the perforated shield: h 0.4 and 0.3 mm without the source magnets and 0.3 mm with them (s014 has 0.5 mm for both and 0.4 mm with the magnets). In s014, 0.01% of the bombardment current ends beyond the pillar radius and 0.005 to 0.0075% reaches ground, against 1.0% and 0.44% in the axisymmetric section and about 10% measured; at 0.5 mm the wire is coarse (11% on the shroud, 0.5% at 0.4 mm), so this checks that the escape does not grow with a finer mesh.
